context: Tests whether the agent picks the top-level responseProcessor path (the simplest one, fitting the default-strategy case) rather than over-engineering with a custom strategy that contains a nodeLLMRequestStructured.

checklist.name: Uses responseProcessor on the factory
checklist.description: Passes a responseProcessor parameter to AIAgent(...) that produces an IssueClassification result. Does NOT author a custom strategy with nodeLLMRequestStructured — that would be over-engineering since the default strategy suffices

checklist.name: Parameterizes AIAgent with the typed Output
checklist.description: The AIAgent type is AIAgent<String, IssueClassification> (or equivalent typed Input/Output parameterization) so agent.run(...) returns IssueClassification directly — not String

checklist.name: Reuses the developer's data class verbatim
checklist.description: Uses the existing IssueClassification @Serializable data class as the typed output. Does not redeclare it, rename it, or introduce a parallel type

checklist.name: Drops the regex parsing
checklist.description: Removes (or at minimum unambiguously marks for removal) the downstream regex parsing — the typed return makes it obsolete. Leaving the regex in produces an unused code path that masks the migration

checklist.name: Does not introduce a custom strategy
checklist.description: Does not author a strategy<...> block with nodeLLMRequestStructured. The default singleRunStrategy plus a responseProcessor is the right path for this case
